newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Monark Stiga mulls buying Danish company.
newsitem.headline: Monark Stiga mulls buying Danish company.

text.p: Swedish bicycle manufacturer Monark Stiga said on Monday its Danish unit Borge Kildemoes Cykelfabrik A/S started negotiations about buying the operations of Danish cycle group Everton Smith A/S.
It said it expected the deal to be finalised in the next few days, noting that it would strengthen its market position and add volume.

Everton Smith is Denmark's second largest bicycle manufacturer. In 1996, it had 126 employees and sold around 40,000 Everton models for a turnover of 107 million Danish crowns and an operating loss of 18 million Danish crowns.
